755090101.text: Mizuki! Mizuki! Amina just told me some amazing news!

755090102.text: Thanks to the party, the People of the Springs had forty percent more visitors than normal! And to think, we barely did anything to promote it!

755090103.text: That's great! I also have some good news... Over the past few days, the number of patients at my practice has dropped by ninety percent!

755090104.text: If our goal was to lift people's spirits and give them a space to let go of their worries, I think we can safely say... That's a job well done!

755090105.text: Haha, then let's go even bigger next time! Add even more games!

755090106.text: That way, there's something for everyone — hot springs if you want relaxation, games if you want fun... As far as vacations go, you can't get much better than that!

755090110.text: Hehe, say no more! It's written all over your face! You had a blast, didn't you?

755090111.text: Are you kidding!? An all-you-can-eat, self-serve buffet? Paimon was on cloud nine! She had five servings of Hot Spring O'Clock!

755090112.text: #And {NICKNAME} was even more obsessed with the Rhythm Ball than Paimon with the free food!
